svg.title: Retained baseline generation speed
svg.desc: Thirty baseline observations and six medians. At 2k, 8k and 32k input targets, 2k-output medians are 19.23, 20.09 and 18.94 tokens per second; 8k-output medians are 25.47, 24.09 and 24.29. All six cells have five observations. Each small point is one successful primary observation in the same baseline process; large diamonds are medians of five, and lines span the observed minimum to maximum. These are accepted generation tokens per second, excluding prefill, not confidence intervals.
